name: career-platform
description: Monorepo for the career platform's engine and shared Supabase schema

scripts.db:test: python3 scripts/stack_lock.py python3 scripts/pgtap_stage.py supabase test db
scripts.job-hunter:install: cd apps/job-hunter && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -e '.[test,webhook]'
scripts.job-hunter:test: python3 scripts/stack_lock.py --shared bash -c 'cd apps/job-hunter && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -n auto --dist=loadgroup "$@"' _
